notes.title: Patch 0.7b
notes.content:
This patch was mostly focused on polishing the Seducer Avatar and Reworking 1 event battle and 1 story boss battle. There is also multiple small bug fixes,

1.- Tweaked some NPCs, Loreki position and Lucky is now named Shaire and some terrain issues.
2.- Fixed some instances where the player is named incorrectly when picking the Seducer.
3.- The seducer sprite shouldn't appear incorrectly now when entering the Dojo and other scenes
4.- Goonnies at the Forest are less likely to be blocked by trees
5.- Fixed a bug where Elusive Dance kept showing a wrong status icon
6.- Fixed a major bug where the player would stay dead after battle when there is a guest party member and getting a Game Over when returning to the Guild.
7.- Erratic Whispers no longer ignores defense and has a different damage formula
8- Reworked Artifact battle for Seducer
9.- Reworked a certain Major Story Boss. Multiple players reported that it was a very confusing battle. The battle should be much more clean and less confusing. It was simplified and has extra dialogue in-battle to help the player.
10.- Another Major Story Boss no longer inflicts Curse.
11.- Mana Drain on the player was reduced from 8 -> 5. This benefits the player.
12.- The player should be able to learn Goonie Barrier level 2 as intended when entering the Illusory Forest.
13.- Flute upgrade appears now in Crafting
14.- There was a pushable rock at the Mountain Pass that blocked the path and potentially soft locking the player. Now the player can push it in a new direction and the soft lock shouldn't be possible anymore.
15.- Tweaked some Monster stats, reducing the difficulty in some scenarios.
16.- Added a Weakness Chart over the Tutorial Menu.

There is still some polishing to do. I appreciate all the feedback you have given.

The next patch will likely be a small one. I mostly want to make sure the Seducer is working properly.
The patch 0.8 will feature new content, but it will take some time to make. Your patience is highly appreciated.

Thanks!

notes.title: Patch 0.7 Live!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Version 0.7[/b][/h1]

[b]Main Story:[/b]
1.- Uncover even more mysteries about the Anomalies spreading through The World.

[b]SideQuests added:[/b]

1.- Help a certain Shopkeeper gain confidence and increase his reputation by accompanying him on a Forest full of illussions! (Full side quest)
2.- Help an Alchemist to explore Ancient Technologic Ruins! (Progress only)
3.- Visit the oneiric realm and meet a Dream Traveler. (Progress only)
4.- A new training at the Dojo (Progress only)
5.- Help a humble Kobold to find his Lost precious Book. (Full side quest)
6- Help the Monster Caretaker bring even more monsters to the Monster Yard. (Progress only)
7- Satisfy a Sea Creature by finding shiny objects for her collection! (Progress only)
8- Get a rematch with a certain gentleman (Full side quest)

[b]New Artwork:[/b]

No animatons this time, but there will be several new pictures! Some are still as "Work In Progress" but they will be updated as time goes.

Artwork can be missed temporary, sometimes by choice of the player or doing badly in Side-Quests. The feature to recover Artwork is not implemented yet. Keep in mind recovering Artwork will be pricey in-game,

Although Artwork can be recovered, the scene itself won't, or at least is not planned, so do your best on Side-Quests!

[b]New Locations:[/b]

1- Mountain Pass
2- Mysterious Island small section
3- Ancient Ruins
4- Illusive Forest

[b]Balance and Gameplay:[/b]

Overall the difficulty has been adjusted at the begining to be easier to give some time for the player learn mechanics. The difficulty will rank up progressively.

1.- Some skills has been adjusted to do better damage
2.- Added a new Special Skill for the Pawssion Gauge
3.- Added new weapons/Accesories 
4.- New level cap is 15
5.- New Skills
6.- A few more Friendly Monsters
7.- Yard Gold Donation Box (buy monsters basically)
8.- More Purchasables over the Badge Shop
9.- A few more Recipes, Life Potion and Energy Potion recipe changed and other tweaked
10.- More NPCs, some of them has something to give you
11.- Adrenaline Potion works now.

[b]Quality of Life:[/b]

1.- Item popups that doesn't pause the flow of the game
2.- "!" Icon now shows up in cases where an important event has taken place, this will help to not forget some stuff.
3.- WIP icon in all the things that cannot be done or cannot be unlocked.
4.- More Tutorial pages to cover all new things. 

[b]Crafting:[/b]

Life Escense and Mind Escense will be able to be crafted using several monster loot. It will be a new use rather than just selling them.

Any Escense is relatively rare, so crafting them will be a expensive loot wise 

[b]Bugs and known issues:[/b]

There has been some lag / low performance issues. Know that I'm investigating and trying to optimize the game. Regardless if you have any issues about this or any other glitch let me know!

[b]What's next:[/b]
Thank you for your patience! I know I've been slow, I'm developing the game mostly on my own with some occasional help from people and friends and I realized in the process that it's even harder than I ever thought. This patch is finally done and I hope you enjoy the new content!
Once again, thank youd deeply for your patience and for playing the game!

All feedback is welcome!

notes.title: Upcoming v0.7 Content and Price change
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you all for your constant patience, support and feedback. I know I've been delaying the "second part" of the patch and I want to apologize for that. On the good side though it turned out to be a whole new version on its own now with more content. 

I'm trying my best to release the patch as soon as posible Early 2024. I deeply appreciate your patience.


As the game continues development the price may increase. The new price will go up to 15$ the next big patch and the game content will increase, most likely doubling the lenght of the game so far.

[b]New content:[/b]

The next content will focus more on Side-Quests this time, which are relatively easier or faster to complete than Main Quests.

[list]
[*] Help a certain Shopkeeper gain confidence and increase his reputation by accompanying him on a Forest full of illussions!
[*] Help an Alchemist to explore Ancient Technologic Ruins!
[*] Explore the vast mountains and find mysteries along the way in order to discover more of the World.
[*] Visit the oneiric realm and meet a Dream Traveler.
[*] Prove yourself at the Dojo in new challenges.
[*] Help a humble Kobold to find his Lost precious Book.
[*] Help the Monster Caretaker bring even more monsters to the Monster Yard.
[*] Uncover even more mysteries about the Anomalies spreading through the World.
[*] Satisfy a Sea Creature by finding shiny objects for her collection!
[*] Get a rematch with a certain gentleman
[*] And meet even more characters who will need your help in the future!
[/list]

I may add even more stuff in the process.

Let me know your thoughts!

notes.title: Version 0.6
notes.content:
Hello!

The patch 0.6 is here! However, I'll be splitting the patch into 2 parts. This is mostly because there is still unfinished/untested content and I rather not rush it. So meanwhile I'll update you with all the new battle mechanics, Quality of Life improvements, Visual improvements and more.

[b]IMPORTANT: Past saves are uncompatible, if you try to load a save it may give you an error.[/b]

[b]What is new?[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Movement:[/b] The player now can move in diagonal and run by holding the mouse button.
[*][b]Difficulty:[/b] After a lot of feedback, I decided to adjust the difficuty, after all, is the begining of the game and letting the player learn everything first is always a better choice. Regardless, the difficulty will increase as the player progresses in the game. 
[*][b]Battle HUD:[/b] New custom and improved Battle HUD, this will help giving the game more personality!
[*][b]Combo System:[/b] Rather than using QTE like with Timing Attacks, this time the skills will have enhanced effects based on how the player chains their attacks. More reliable too!
[*][b]Party members:[/b] A certain character is now playable! (temporaly)
[*][b]Pawssion Gauge System[/b]: There will be a new Gauge that will fill by using Combos. This Gauge will increase its charges as you gain affection and complete quests through the game. These abilities will be an extra resource for the player.
[*][b]Items:[/b] Items no longer consumes the player turn, instead they will be set on cooldown. Upon usage the item category may be set on cooldown while others may set the whole inventory in cooldown, it will depend on the item.
[*][b]New content:[/b] There is slightly more content than before! A very small scenario and a new boss fight.
[*][b]New characters: [/b]Even though these dont have a full conversation yet.
[*]Added Battle Animations speed in the options settings.
[*]Potions usage has changed to Battle Only. You can find Field healing items at the Shop.
[/list]
[b]
As for the second half of the patch, it will have the new locations, enemies, quests and Artwork. But that will have to wait a bit more! [/b]

[b]Back to the Saves:[/b]
Due the new mechanics and features being implemented, specially the new Battle HUD, past saves are no longer compatible, even if they show up when you load the game.
These may keep happening on the future! So keep in mind, since this is an Early Access and many unexpected issues may keep appearing until the full release.
Regardless if there is a Save Wipe I'll try to give rewards like I did with the previous 2 Passwords for Costumes.
_____

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*]Sttutering in the Forest: Some players has experienced some sttutering while running or walking in the Forest, it shouldn't cause any crash or anything. I'm currently trying to fix it.
If you encounter a bug, please let me know!
[*]Outdated Potions tutorial
[*]First Aid Kits dissapears from the shop sometimes.
[/list]

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Costume Rewards before Save Wipe + Patch details
notes.content:
As mentioned in a previous announcement, the next patch will make the Save Files incompatible, so everyone will have to start over. However, to compensate for that, I added a Diamond NPC at Town.
This NPC will give you a Password reward based on how far you got in the game and how much you completed. These Passwords will give you a Costume Ticket each. These Tickets will unlock any skin for you once the Costume Menu is available.

Goal 1: Defeat a powerful enemy in a Dank place.
Goal 2: Reach 14% Completion rate.

Just to clarify, the passwords won't be usable until the Costume Menu is available.

The deadline is August 6th (unless I delay the patch).

[b]Patch Details[/b]
I plan on patching on August 6th, so I'll try to add as much content before that. I'll probably divide the big patch into 2 segments though.

Thanks for the support, any questions let me know!

notes.title: Upcoming Patch 0.6 Details, Upgrades and Save files
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 
First of all, thank you for supporting the game in this early state!

I've been collecting feedback and took some decisions that I think it will make the game even better.

Let's start witht the bad news...

[b]Possible uncompatibility with past Saves.[/b]

As I upgrade the game, some uncompatibilities may happen at some point, I just didn't thought it would be so early. Regardless, I have learnt some stuff about it and I'll take more cautious approach on things in the future.

Possible compensation:
In compensation for those who advanced a lot, I'll attempt to add an NPC who will give a password based on how far you got, and once you start a new file, you can input the password and collect your reward. (At least this is the plan, if for some reason something changes or something prevents it from being implemented, I'll let you know).

[b]Timing Attacks Removed:[/b]

These were causing me a headache to program properly, and a lot of players found it little intuitive and difficult to use.
These will be replaced by a Combo System explained below


Now let's go for the good news!

[b]New HUD system, diagonal movement and movement speed increase while holding the left mouse button.[/b]

[previewyoutube=eL9WI_3tgss;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










[b]Combo System[/b]

Rather than using QTE like with Timing Attacks, this time the skills will have enhanced effects based on how the player chains their attacks.

Example:

[b]Heal: [/b]Heal a small amount.
Combo: If used after using Focus > Remove all basic status ailments.
[b]
Pawssion Gauge System[/b]  (temptative name)

There will be a new Gauge that will fill by using Combos (it's visible in the video above with a Heart icon). This Gauge will increase its size as you gain affection and complete quests through the game.
These abilities will be an extra resource for the player.

[b]Items:[/b]
Items no longer consumes the player turn, instead they will be set on cooldown. Upon usage the item category may be set on cooldown while others may set the whole inventory in cooldown, it will depend on the item.

[b]When the patch will be released?[/b]

I plan to patch a portion at the end of July, othewise it may take an additional month or two. It depends on how smoothly the development goes.


Thanks a lot of the support and the feedback.
